column1: # The texts of the PB Store interface, English: one line per text, the key, a TAB, the text. \n, \t and \\ are escapes.
# Keys are page.element (the page or part that shows the text, then a short name of the text). QML uses qsTr("key"), the bridge tr("key");
# bridge/include/table_translator.h looks the key up here. scripts/extract-strings.py --check: every key used exists, every key is used.

column2: PB Store browses the signed catalog of apps for the PocketBook InkPad One. It contacts the catalog host and the host of the package address of an app, and nothing else; it does nothing until you tap a button, and it sends no identifier.
